The brown carpet is inside the building, so the player needs to enter through the doorway and face the carpet on the floor. max_distance=5 ensures the player is inside or at the doorway of the building, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward the carpet.

scene_description: A small village area with three distinct buildings made of different materials (oak planks, spruce planks, stone bricks). Each building contains a different colored carpet on the floor: brown carpet in the oak building, red carpet in the spruce building, and lime carpet in the stone building. The player must explore the area and enter the correct building to find the brown carpet. Lanterns, a villager, and a cat serve as visual landmarks.
task_text: Find the brown carpet. Explore the small village and look inside the buildings to locate a brown carpet block on the floor.
design_notes: Three buildings arranged around the player spawn: oak planks building (NE, ~5-9, ~5-9) with brown carpet at ~7,~0,~7; spruce planks building (SW, ~-8 to -4, ~-8 to -4) with red carpet as a decoy; stone bricks building (SE, ~-3 to 1, ~5-9) with lime carpet as another decoy. Each building has a 1-wide doorway facing the center. Lanterns at ~3,~0,~0 and ~-2,~0,~0 serve as path markers. Villager and cat near spawn add visual context. The brown carpet is only visible once the player enters the oak building through its south-facing door.
